do_not_assume: Do not assume C-FRESHNESS is VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE — it remains EXPERIMENTAL; orthogonality confirmed at delta=0.15 under stochastic mock on localhost only

Do not assume calibrated threshold 0.20 is a discriminating operating point — FP constraint is never binding (noise 0.05-0.14 fully separated from failure 0.20-0.39 by design), so no discrimination was tested under overlapping distributions

Do not assume threshold tautology is fully resolved — calibrated threshold moved from 0.25 bimodal to 0.20 continuous low edge, not to middle range as hypothesized; TP=1.0 still at calibrated threshold
Do not assume continuous severity mapping generalizes to production — hand-designed 50/50 partial/full success within 70%, failure 20-39%, noise 5-14%; production refresh quality distribution unknown

Do not assume that because 6 mock experiments confirm orthogonality, production endpoints will behave identically — real OAuth/OIDC, CDN, and network RTT may introduce correlated structural-behavioral variation
Do not assume the TOST resolution at n=480 proves orthogonality is a universal property — it confirms mock-ceiling orthogonality at this sample size, not production orthogonality
Do not assume the structural discrimination 0.8333 generalizes to production OAuth/OIDC, CDN, or non-deterministic endpoints — claim ceiling bounded to Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 localhost
Do not assume error_format_variation was previously untested — it is now fixed and verified effective in this experiment (structural_std 0.4017 > 0.15)
Do not assume the 6th mock confirmation adds independent evidence beyond the 5th — all use the same Flask+SQLite+JWT architecture; the independent variable is severity mapping, not infrastructure
